items.title: The Extra Down: Eli Anders Unexpected Path to No. 97
items.summary: A four-game football suspension during his senior year of high school helped set Georgia Southern defensive lineman Eli Anders on a path he never expected to take.

items.title: GAME PREVIEW: Old Rivals Renew Acquaintances Saturday
items.summary: STATESBORO - Old rivals renew acquaintances Saturday night as Georgia State and App State face off in Allen E. Paulson Stadium  in Sun Belt Conference action.

items.title: From Player to Coach: Darius Safford’s Journey Comes Full Circle Against App State
items.summary: When Darius Safford transferred to Georgia Southern in 2013, he quickly learned that the rivalry with App State was about more than football. Known as "Deeper Than Hate," the rivalry would become a defining part of his time as an Eagle, shaping his perspective on the program and fueling a coaching journey that has brought him back to Statesboro in a leadership role.

items.title: Rivalry Showdown Set for Halloween Night at Paulson Stadium
items.summary: STATESBORO, Ga. – Georgia Southern Athletics is preparing for a special Halloween Saturday as the Eagles welcome rival App State to Allen E. Paulson Stadium/Evans Family Field on Oct. 31 at 6:30 p.m.

items.title: Bynum, Bryant Honored by Sun Belt
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS - Georgia Southern football players Anthony Bynum and Tripp Bryant were honored by the Sun Belt Conference as players of the week, as announced Monday by the conference.

items.title: Helton, Defense Leads Eagles to Big Road Win at ODU
items.summary: NORFOLK, Va. — Behind a big night from Turner Helton and the defense, Georgia Southern defeated Old Dominion 23-15 on Thursday night at Kornblau Field at S.B. Ballard Stadium.

items.title: The Extra Down: MJ Stroud's Steady Climb to the Top
items.summary: For fifth-year outside linebacker MJ Stroud, becoming a defensive force at Georgia Southern began with a position change he never expected to make.

items.title: GAME PREVIEW: Thursday Night Lights On Tap For Eagles
items.summary: STATESBORO - The Georgia Southern football team travels to S.B. Ballard Stadium Thursday to take on Old Dominion in Sun Belt Conference action.

items.title: Late Rally Falls Just Short to Dukes
items.summary: STATESBORO, Ga. — Georgia Southern came up just short to James Madison, falling 27-24 on Saturday at Allen E. Paulson Stadium.

items.title: Georgia Southern-James Madison Game to Proceed as Scheduled
items.summary: STATESBORO, Ga. – Georgia Southern Athletics has confirmed that tonight's football game against James Madison at Allen E. Paulson Stadium will proceed as scheduled (7:30 p.m.; ESPNU).
